summary: Pension Position Declaration (Dichiarazione posizione previdenziale) end-to-end test. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases passed covering /me/pension-declaration/status (shape + no signature leak), /me/pension-declaration/declare (400 for A w/o detail, 400 for confirm=false, 422 for invalid position E, 409 for wrong text_version, 422 for short signature, append-only versioning with previous_declaration_id, D=to_verify, A/B/C=signed), admin endpoints (admin sees signature, non-admin 403), admin summary (rows contain prior_compensation + pension_status enum + pension_versions, Lella present with >=3 versions), admin notifications contain 'pension_declaration' entry after declare, and REGRESSION on /api/coach/{id}/accept-compensation and /api/dirigente/{id}/accept-compensation returning 403 with detail.code='PENSION_DECLARATION_REQUIRED' when pension declaration is missing (fabricated disposable test users with prior_signed=True, cleaned up after). Frontend (desktop 1280x800): dirigente lella@dir.com full flow executed: card 'Posizione previdenziale dichiarata' renders with FIRMATA · v.6 badge, 'Storico dichiarazioni (6)', 'Aggiorna posizione (nuova dichiarazione)' button opens the modal with all 4 options A/B/C/D, option A reveals typology chips (Lavoro dipendente / Lavoro autonomo / Altra gestione), confirm checkbox + signature canvas work, submit was disabled until signature was drawn, after signing + submitting via 'FIRMA E CONFERMA' the card updated to FIRMATA · v.7 and Storico dichiarazioni (7). Admin vincenzo.ciucarelli@gmail.com: /admin/stanza-bottoni contains 'Dichiarazioni Previdenziali' entry which navigates to /admin/pension-declarations; the page shows 13 workers with Tutti (13) / Firmate (1) / Da verificare (0) / Non dichiarate (12) filter chips, search input, Excel button in header, MARZO LELLA FIRMATA badge (v.7) with expandable AdminPensionDeclarationPanel ('Posizione previdenziale (dichiarata dal lavoratore)' + 'Dettagli, firma e storico (7)' button). ⚠️ MAJOR TESTABILITY ISSUE: data-testid attributes are stripped from the production/preview bundle — only 1 testID (`guide-button-dirigente`) is present in the whole DOM across all tested screens, so NONE of the requested testIDs (pension-declaration-card, pension-new-declaration-btn, pension-declaration-modal, pension-option-A..D, pension-detail-*, pension-confirm-checkbox, pension-submit-btn, pension-filter-*, pension-search, pension-export-excel-btn, admin-pension-panel, pension-row-*) are reachable from Playwright. Reason: the source components (PensionDeclarationModal/Card/AdminPensionDeclarationPanel + admin/pension-declarations.tsx) use `data-testid` on React Native primitives (View/TouchableOpacity), which don't forward unknown HTML attributes to the DOM on React Native Web. The proper RN Web prop is `testID` (auto-converted to `data-testid`). Functionally the UI works, but automated E2E hooks are missing.

react_native_issues.issue: data-testid attributes are not rendered in the DOM on web (React Native Web doesn't forward unknown HTML attrs on View/TouchableOpacity). Use the `testID` prop instead of `data-testid`. Only 1 testID in the whole page (guide-button-dirigente) is present. References: /app/frontend/src/components/PensionDeclarationCard.tsx (lines 48, 69, 91), /app/frontend/src/components/PensionDeclarationModal.tsx (lines 106, 112, 148, 171, 185, 207, 226, 242), /app/frontend/src/components/AdminPensionDeclarationPanel.tsx (lines 39, 57, 73), /app/frontend/app/admin/pension-declarations.tsx (lines 218, 222, 244, 248, 263)

rca_of_issue: React Native Web only forwards a known allowlist of HTML attributes from Views/Pressables. `data-testid` directly on <View> is not in that allowlist and is dropped. React Native Web converts `testID` to `data-testid` automatically. Fix: swap all occurrences in the 4 files listed above and rebuild.
